Build n8n VNTANA node; MVP Products/Auth. Use declarative JSON routing, not `execute()`. Base `https://api-platform.vntana.com`; auth `X-AUTH-TOKEN`; login→refresh-token with organizationUuid; store org-specific token in credentials. Responses `{ success, errors, response }`.

All new operations must have unit tests. Run tests before any manual testing:
If it doesn't work with curl, it won't work with n8n. Always verify API calls work:
curl -X POST "https://api-platform.vntana.com/v1/<endpoint>" \
-H "Content-Type: application/json" \
-H "X-AUTH-TOKEN: Bearer <token>" \
npm run build
<REDACTED_USERPATH>/GitHub/VNTANA-n8n-node/.claude/skills/n8n-relink/scripts/relink.sh
Only after curl verification succeeds.

Always bump the version when committing changes to node code (`nodes/` or `credentials/`).
When committing changes that affect `nodes/` or `credentials/`:
npm version patch
npm version minor
npm version major
git push origin main --tags

GitHub repo must be public. Run scanner locally first:
npx <REDACTED_USER>/scan-community-package n8n-nodes-vntana@latest
All code must use `httpRequest`; `this.helpers.request()` is not allowed.
npm run build
npm version patch
git push origin main --tags
npx <REDACTED_USER>/scan-community-package n8n-nodes-vntana@<new-version>

Use `returnFullResponse: true`, NOT `resolveWithFullResponse`. Docs: `documentation/`.
